chunks: ʿAlī narrated from his father, from al-Nawfalī, from al-Sukūnī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Whoever retaliation is carried out upon, and he dies, then he is one slain by the Qur'an.

key_terms.اقْتُصَّ: retaliation was exacted; qiṣāṣ was carried out upon someone
key_terms.الْقُرْآنِ: the Qur'an, meaning the divine ruling and authority conveyed by it
key_terms.فَمَاتَ: then he died as a result

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when a person killed in qiṣāṣ is called "slain by the Qur'an"?
ai.summary: This hadith states that when a person dies as a result of lawful qiṣāṣ being carried out, his death is attributed to the judgment of the Qur'an. It underscores the legitimacy of divinely sanctioned retaliation within the justice system.
